required_changes: Require exactly one normalized official ASC grid per required 10km tile before sampling.
Group raw candidates by SHA256; retain all source-member receipts.
Allow collapse only for byte-identical duplicate ASC members.
Fail closed when more than one distinct ASC SHA exists for a tile.
Publish raw_member_count, distinct_sha_count, selected_sha and dedup_reason.
Feed only the selected normalized grid to _sample_tiles.
Bind selected SHA to tile ID, 200x200/50m/origin fingerprint and metadata provenance.
